title: CompTIA DataAI
summary: CompTIA DataAI is a vendor certification offered by CompTIA. This independent study guide covers all 5 objective domains: Mathematics and statistics, Modeling, analysis, and outcomes, Machine learning, Operations and processes, Specialized applications of data science. Each domain is broken into 25 lessons in total, and every lesson has a MEDIUM and a HARD scenario exam. The exams use realistic workplace situations rather than recall questions, so you practise applying each objective the way the job asks for it.
attributionNote: CompTIA certification content is an independent study guide written for CyberPulseAcademy and is not affiliated with or endorsed by CompTIA.
